baseline_models.mechanism: A stable recitation is turned through successive forms to restore its matter to memory, while the response is measured as cumulative movement in the opposite direction.

activation_trace.role: Turning speech and verses from face to face supplies the repeated transformation operation.
Reading and recitation supply the stable communicative object carried through those transformations.
A reminder that makes something present supplies the intended endpoint of the operation.
Growth and addition supply the cumulative feedback measure.
Recoil and distancing supply the observed direction of that growth.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports that a reminder was repeated but rejected.
changed_reading.after: The Qur'anic address is adaptively rotated through distinct forms to restore presence in memory, but each pass adds another increment of distance.

baseline_models.mechanism: The Qur'an gathers material, recollection gathers an absent matter back into awareness, and diversification gives the gathered whole multiple faces; aversion then acts as a centrifugal counterforce.

activation_trace.role: Gathering dispersed elements makes the Qur'an the centripetal container.
Restoring something after forgetting gives recollection its inward return.
Differentiation into successive faces explains how one gathered whole can be varied.
Distancing reverses both textual gathering and mnemonic return.

changed_reading.before: The content fails to persuade its audience.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages opposite vectors: textual gathering and recollection pull inward, while reception breaks outward into distance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: صَرَّفْنَا فِى هَذَا الْقُرْآنِ ... وَمَا يَزِيدُهُمْ إِلَّا نُفُورًا
baseline_models.mechanism: Audience-directed modulation of speech is meant to incline ears and hearts, yet the only registered increment is repulsion; the communicative vector reverses at reception.

activation_trace.role: Modulating and augmenting speech to incline hearers supplies the intended attractive force.
Recitation supplies the audible medium on which that rhetorical tuning operates.
Making the matter present supplies the intended cognitive uptake.
Increment supplies the observable output of repeated exposure.
Recoil converts intended inclination into its spatial opposite.

changed_reading.before: The same teaching is restated for emphasis.
changed_reading.after: The teaching is deliberately tuned toward its hearers, but the attempted attraction is converted at reception into accumulating repulsion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus is bracketed by an exposed false attribution, a counterfactual pursuit toward the throne, and transcendent negation. These are not mere repetitions but rotations of one refutation through accusation, hypothetical consequence, spatial test, and doxology.

activation_trace.role: Turning discourse from face to face names the modal rotation that the surrounding sequence performs.
The reminder branch makes the rotations converge on renewed recognition rather than novelty for its own sake.
Attributing what did not occur supplies the false claim that the rotating refutation targets.
Seeking turns the asserted plurality into a testable counterfactual action.
A traversable path spatializes the consequence of that hypothetical pursuit.
Transcendent exoneration closes the sequence by negating the premise at a different register.

structural_cues: 17:40 exposes an attribution, 17:42 converts it into a counterfactual route, and 17:43 answers with transcendent negation around the focus statement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies successive argumentative modes; I identify their shared directional change as instances of صَرَّفْنَا. They could alternatively be adjacent refutations without a designed modal sequence.

changed_reading.before: Diversification means generic repetition in different words.
changed_reading.after: Diversification is a deliberate refutational method that rotates one claim through rhetorical, logical, spatial, and devotional modes so recognition can occur from more than one entry point.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recitation meets an access barrier, a covered pivoting heart, and a weighted ear; the failed inward transfer is then externalized as turning the back and moving away.

activation_trace.role: Recitation supplies the signal entering the reception chain.
Restoration after forgetting supplies the inward uptake that the chain should produce.
Prevention of access places a barrier between recitation and uptake.
Turning a thing from its face makes the heart the pivot where textual turning can become human reversal.
A protective covering supplies the enclosed state of that pivot.
Literal heaviness in the ear supplies a receptor-level obstruction.
Turning away supplies the first outward motion produced by failed reception.
The repeated recoil branch names the completed movement into distance.

structural_cues: 17:45 begins with Qur'an-recitation and a hidden barrier; 17:46 moves through heart and ear obstructions to turned backs and repeats نُفُورًا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the barriers, sensory sites, and retreat verbs; I supply the causal arrow from blocked inward reception to outward flight. They may instead be parallel descriptions of one settled stance.

changed_reading.before: The audience freely hears the reminder and then chooses aversion.
changed_reading.after: The context anatomizes a failed transmission: recitation reaches covered and weighted reception, pivots at the heart, and exits as bodily retreat.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hearing is followed by private recoding, a hostile label, and rival examples; later verbal provocation between people supplies the propagation mechanism. Aversion is therefore socially processed, not only individually felt.

activation_trace.role: Audience-directed modulation of speech supplies the communicative input that a rival rhetoric counterprocesses.
Distancing remains the focus-anchored output of the social process.
Repeated auditory perception supplies reception without yet implying assent.
Secret counsel supplies the private chamber in which the heard message is recoded.
A saying that spreads among people supplies circulation of the hostile recoding.
Diversion and deception supply the label used to invert rhetorical attraction into suspicion.
Forming and displaying an example supplies the opponents' competing explanatory frame.
The struck comparison gives that rival frame a portable rhetorical form.
Interpersonal agitation supplies the arrow from hostile wording to division between hearers.

structural_cues: 17:47 repeats listening, then moves to secret counsel and a hostile label; 17:48 adds rival examples, while 17:53 explicitly locates verbal agitation between people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hearing, private counsel, labels, examples, and agitation; I connect them as a social feedback loop that manufactures distance. Counsel and examples could instead merely express an aversion already complete.

changed_reading.before: Each hearer independently recoils from the recitation.
changed_reading.after: The heard recitation is privately recoded, circulated through hostile labels and examples, and amplified between people until individual reception becomes social distance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The discourse turns the resurrection objection through disintegration, arousal, stone, iron, return, first origination, and call-response. Diversification becomes a controlled traversal of material and temporal states that rehearses reassembly.

activation_trace.role: Movement from state to state supplies the governing operation for the material sequence.
Gathering supplies a latent counteroperation to fragmentation and a model for recomposition.
Restoring what was absent supplies the cognitive analogue of material return.
Fragmentation and debris supply the disassembled starting state.
Arousing the still from rest supplies the transition out of that state.
Hard stone supplies one resistant material extreme through which the argument turns.
Iron and unyielding solidity supply a second resistant material extreme.
Return after departure supplies the temporal reversal toward renewed embodiment.
First origination supplies the prior operation that warrants re-creation.
Calling by speech supplies the final activating signal.
Answering speech supplies the completed response of the reassembled hearers.

structural_cues: 17:49 begins with bones and fragments, 17:50 tests harder material states, 17:51 joins return to first origination, and 17:52 resolves the sequence in call and answer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered material and temporal transitions; I read them as one pedagogical transformation sequence governed by صَرَّفْنَا. They could alternatively be discrete rebuttal examples with no material analogy to Qur'anic gathering.

changed_reading.before: The Qur'an varies wording so the audience will remember a doctrine.
changed_reading.after: The discourse makes the audience mentally traverse disassembly, resistant matter, return, and response; remembering becomes a rehearsal of the very recomposition they deny.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later denial that invoked beings can remove harm or transform it activates the diversion branch of ص ر ف. The One who turns discourse can alter states, while supposed mediators cannot; aversion may register resistance to that loss of intermediary agency.

activation_trace.role: Turning something away from a direction, including harm, anchors the focus in effective diversion.
Recoil supplies the audience response to the claim of exclusive transforming agency.
Possession and disposal supply the agency explicitly denied to the invoked beings.
Removing a covering supplies the concrete operation those beings cannot perform on harm.
Harm and loss supply the state awaiting removal or diversion.
Transformation from one state to another supplies the unavailable power at issue.
Seeking supplies the dependence of the invoked beings rather than independent control.
Nearness supplies the direction toward which those dependent seekers move.

structural_cues: 17:56 denies removal and transformation of harm to invoked beings; 17:57 portrays those same beings as seekers moving toward nearness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a lexical transformation contrast and dependent seekers; I connect it to the divine subject of صَرَّفْنَا and infer that displaced mediation can provoke recoil. The verses may instead make a separate agency claim unrelated to the mechanics of 17:41.

changed_reading.before: The audience dislikes varied religious discourse.
changed_reading.after: Varied discourse also demonstrates who can truly divert and transform states; the audience's recoil may answer the exposure of its mediators as dependent and ineffective.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible signs, denial, warning, and trial culminate in a near-repeat of the focus syntax: Qur'anic warning only increases tyranny. Increase therefore functions as an assay that exposes and magnifies an existing response vector, with aversion and transgression as distinct outputs.

activation_trace.role: Repeated transformation supplies successive test inputs rather than a single exposure.
Growth supplies the measurable amplification shared with the later parallel.
Distancing supplies the first output signature of the assay.
A manifest sign supplies an externally legible test input.
Assigning falsehood to the sign supplies the historically repeated failure response.
Inducing fear supplies the stated function of sent signs.
Showing and making visible supply the presented material of the test.
Testing a person as metal is tested supplies the assay model explicitly.
Recitation repeats the same textual medium as the focus.
Induced fear supplies the warning operation immediately before the parallel increase clause.
The repeated growth branch makes the formal parallel with 17:41 measurable.
Exceeding the limit in disobedience supplies the second output signature of the assay.

structural_cues: 17:59 defines signs as warning after recalling prior denial; 17:60 names a trial and repeats the pattern Qur'an or warning plus 'does not increase them except' plus a resistant outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the trial vocabulary and near-isomorphic increase clause; I infer that repeated warning tests and magnifies a prior disposition rather than intending the resistant outcome. A direct causal worsening by exposure remains live.

changed_reading.before: The Qur'an directly makes its resistant audience more averse.
changed_reading.after: Each varied warning acts like a stress test: it reveals and amplifies the audience's prior vector, registering aversion at 17:41 and boundary-crossing tyranny at 17:60.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the secondary ز ي د to ز و د mapping and the martial-mobilization branch of ن ف ر rather than their default senses. It remains anchored in both focus roots and gains a visible social mechanism from secret counsel and interpersonal agitation. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory counter-mobilization reading, not as the lexical default.

activation_trace.role: Provision carried for movement recasts each increment as resources accumulated for departure or action.
Rising for war or support converts passive aversion into organized counter-movement.
Secret counsel supplies a coordination site for that counter-movement.
Agitation between people supplies escalation from recoil to mobilized opposition.

changed_reading.before: Further recitation makes the audience feel more repelled.
changed_reading.after: Each textual increment may provision a privately coordinated counter-muster, so نُفُورًا can name mobilized opposition as well as recoil.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it activates the bodily swelling branch of ن ف ر and treats barriers as a defensive tissue analogy. It remains anchored in the focus's increase plus aversion and in the immediate covering and ear-weight sequence. Downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy for reception, never a literal medical claim.

activation_trace.role: Growth supplies the progressive enlargement of the defensive response.
Diseased skin swelling and lifting from its place supplies the embodied image of defensive separation.
A covering barrier supplies the protective layer in the analogy.
A preserving cover supplies thickened enclosure around the receptive center.
Heaviness in the ear supplies the sensory symptom of that defensive thickening.

changed_reading.before: Aversion simply grows as an attitude.
changed_reading.after: Repeated recitation can be pictured as provoking defensive thickening in reception, with swelling distance, covering, and ear-heaviness forming one embodied response.

strongest_changes: The surrounding argument realizes صَرَّفْنَا as rotation through distinct refutational modes rather than generic repetition.
17:45-46 converts abstract aversion into a reception chain from barrier and weighted ear through a pivoting heart to bodily retreat.
17:49-52 turns variation into a material and temporal rehearsal of disassembly, re-creation, call, and response.
17:60's trial and parallel increase clause recast increase as diagnostic amplification, with aversion and tyranny as two resistant outputs.
summary.what_was_special: The pericope repeatedly materializes the focus's abstract verbs as directional, sensory, social, and reconstructive operations, then closes with a formal warning-and-increase parallel; the split ز ي د mapping and non-default ن ف ر branches preserve two contained readings that a conservative synthesis would likely lose.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether increase primarily causes worsening or exposes and magnifies an already directed disposition remains unresolved.
Whether the gathering branch of ق ر ء is functionally active in the re-creation sequence or only a suggestive lexical analogue remains uncertain.
The exclusive-agency and counter-muster readings may be genuine mechanisms of aversion or only neighboring applications of the same roots.
